lines.zh: 我贴着沙面滑，留下细细的线。
lines.en: I slide over the sand leaving a fine line.

lines.zh: 我的鼻子向上翘，顶着走。
lines.en: My snout turns up and I push along.
I pass under the grass.

lines.zh: 我边走边把沙子翻到身后。
lines.en: As I go I flip sand behind me.

lines.zh: 我在干地上比在湿地上自在。
lines.en: I'm more at home on dry ground.

lines.zh: 我绕着一块小石头走了半圈。
lines.en: I go half around a small stone.

lines.zh: 我又停下来，把头抬起来。
lines.en: I stop again and raise my head.

lines.zh: 我的身子在沙里歪歪地走。
lines.en: My body wanders a crooked line in the sand.
I glide toward the meadow.

lines.zh: 太阳晒得沙子很烫，我走快些。
lines.en: The sand's hot, so I move faster.
I pass a dried grass stalk.
I ease my head into a hole.
I'm coiled on the sand, snout up.
My pattern is dark blotches.
My tongue samples the air.

lines.zh: 我像一块带花纹的石头
lines.en: I look like a patterned stone.
My snout lifts a touch.
Something's moving in the sand.

lines.zh: 我把身体往沙里压了压。
lines.en: I press my body into the sand.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛上蒙着一层膜。
lines.en: A scale covers each eye.
Wind runs over the meadow.
My tongue forks again.
I gather myself in.
I'm very good at playing dead.
My belly rests on warm sand.

lines.zh: 我把鼻子埋进自己盘里
lines.en: I bury my nose inside my own coils.
It's dry here — I like it.
I coil myself rounder.

lines.zh: 一只蚂蚁爬过我的尾巴。
lines.en: An ant crawls over my tail.

lines.zh: 这条尾巴能摊上一整天
lines.en: I can stretch this out all day long.
I claimed this warm sand first.
I turn my head to look at you.
You're covered in dry grass.
I'm not venomous — truly.
Reach for me and I'll play dead.
I'll roll over slowly.
Look — I'm spread out flat.
Watching like this will do.
You're blocking my sun. Move.

lines.zh: 我的舌头卷了一下又收回
lines.en: My tongue curls out and snaps back in.
I've rolled back again.
I back off without taking my eyes off you.
I've flipped over playing dead at once.
My tongue is hanging out.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，像真的死了。
lines.en: I hold still like I'm really dead.
That landed on my body.
Sand's stuck to me.

lines.zh: 肚皮朝天，我扭着翻回来
lines.en: Belly up, I twist myself right again.
I roll myself into a tight ball.
It's a good while before I dare move.
One back scale came off.
I ease back into the grass.
I smell something small.

lines.zh: 我贴着沙朝味道那边去
lines.en: I glide over the sand toward the smell.
This still has warmth in it.
I lean in and sniff. Still warm.
It smells like a mouse.
Set it on the sand. I'm in no hurry.
Not enough to fill my belly.
I caught it in one go.
I swallow it slowly.
I coil up and let it digest.

lines.zh: 你碰到我，我先僵住不动
lines.en: You touch me and I freeze first.

lines.zh: 我翻过来，舌头都伸出来。
lines.en: I've rolled over with my tongue hanging out.
See — I'm dead.
Only after you go do I move.
That nudged me half an inch.
I slowly roll back.
Sand has stuck to me.

lines.zh: 我从你的影子里滑出去。
lines.en: I slide out of your shadow.
We knock together, both slippery.
I've retreated into the grass.
Another comes out of the grass.
Its snout turns up too.

lines.zh: 我们俩的翘鼻都朝着天
lines.en: Our upturned noses both point at the sky.
It rests its head on my coils.
I'm quite good at being liked.
My head tips to one side.

lines.zh: 太阳落下去，我们还趴着。
lines.en: The sun sets and we're still lying there.
It slides away and I stay on the sand.
I return to my old patch of sand.

lines.zh: 那块沙已经被我盘出形了。
lines.en: That sand has taken the shape of my coil.
I take the mouse in one strike.
Down it went in one go.

lines.zh: 这味道冲鼻，我皱起鼻子
lines.en: The smell stings my nostrils, so I wrinkle my nose.
I spat it out — not food.
I push it with my upturned snout.
It rolled into the ditch.
I haul it by the teeth onto dry sand.
I sniff and drop it.

lines.zh: 我把自己盘在这堆东西上
lines.en: I coil myself on top of the pile.
Too hard. My teeth won't sink in.
Something's moving on the sand.
I press my head to the sand.
I'll give it a few steps.
I lie in the sand unseen.

lines.zh: 我把身子叠成几折备着
lines.en: I fold my body into a few tight loops.
I pin it with my stare.
I can get that one down.
I wait for it to come closer.
I slide across the sand.
I raise my upper body out of the sand.

lines.zh: 我顺着它的气味往前贴
lines.en: I hug its scent trail and creep forward.
It goes left; I go through the grass.
I'm pressed very low.
My pattern matches the sand.
It stops, and I ball up.
I creep an inch at a time.
It's pawing at the sand.
My head is half raised.
From this angle I can reach.

lines.zh: 它头再低一点就进我嘴里
lines.en: One dip of its head and it's in my mouth.
My teeth go in.
I coil up along its legs.

lines.zh: 我的身子又绕紧了一节
lines.en: Another length of my body draws tight.
It kicks and twists inside my mouth.
I begin to swallow it.
My mouth is at full stretch.
I swallow it segment by segment.
I coil on the warm sand.
That was a decent meal.
I'm playing dead again.
I push the sand aside with my upturned nose.
The first thing I see is dry grass.
My snout turns up.
The sand's hot, so I shift.

lines.zh: 我的花纹还是最普通的。
lines.en: My markings are the plain sort.

lines.zh: 我把身体摊开来晒太阳。
lines.en: I spread out in the sun.
Then I coil back up.
A bird lands far off.
I flick my tongue out to test.
I glide toward the grass.
I'm not afraid at all.
I start burrowing into the sand.
The moment it touched fire, I sprang away.

lines.zh: 我从沙坡上滚下去，摔平了。
lines.en: I roll off the sand bank and land flat.

lines.zh: 水从我的鼻子灌进来，我沉
lines.en: Water pours in through my nose and I sink.

lines.zh: 我被炸得翻过来，落在草里
lines.en: The blast flips me over into the grass.

lines.zh: 箭从我的鳞上蹭出一道白痕
lines.en: An arrow scrapes a pale line along my scales.
I can't even play dead now.
Too hungry to hold my coil together.
Thunder and my whole length goes rigid.
No sand under me — I drop.
